title: 自有阅读示例
subtitle: 格式演示 · 2 题，非完整模考
review: 格式演示，请补充自己的材料并核对答案。

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text: The fictional Alder collection keeps digital records and printed summaries. The summaries are a precaution against temporary access problems. They are not intended to replace the full database.

questions.prompt: The collection keeps printed ____. Write ONE WORD.
questions.explanation: printed 后的名词为 summaries，注意复数。

questions.prompt: Printed copies are intended to replace the database.
questions.evidence: They are not intended to replace the full database.
questions.explanation: 原文明确否定 replace，与题干相反，因此是 False。
